mapper.select: SELECT m.feedback_source_id AS source_id, s.source_channel, CASE WHEN c.masking_status='PASS' AND c.is_deleted=0 THEN c.title ELSE NULL END AS title, CASE WHEN c.masking_status='PASS' AND c.is_deleted=0 THEN c.description ELSE NULL END AS description, CASE WHEN c.masking_status='PASS' AND c.is_deleted=0 THEN c.function_module ELSE NULL END AS function_module, CASE WHEN c.masking_status='PASS' AND c.is_deleted=0 THEN c.issue_category ELSE NULL END AS issue_category, c.masking_status, c.is_deleted FROM t_cluster_shadow_candidate_member m INNER JOIN t_feedback_source s ON s.id=m.feedback_source_id INNER JOIN t_feedback_content c ON c.source_id=m.feedback_source_id WHERE m.generation_id=#{generationId} AND m.cluster_key_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.feedback_source_id
